claims.always_finds_exact_optimum: SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS: all 45 best decoded routes are exact, but not a claim of sampling or optimizer reliability

experiment_b_rationale: n=4 p2/p3 heterogeneity and universal termination uncertainty make initialization/optimizer robustness a prerequisite
experiment_c_rationale: n=4 P_optimal is typically 10^-4 to 10^-3 in corrected cells, so exact-statevector probability is not operational finite-shot success

gap_and_exact_route.interpretation: gap=0 means best decoded feasible route equals exact optimum; it does not imply high P_optimal, sampling success, optimizer convergence, finite-shot success, robustness, or quantum advantage

limitations: five deterministic reproducibility instances per n, not representative random population

optimizer.conclusion: optimizer convergence cannot be established from this formal evidence

sample_selection: reproducibility and instance heterogeneity evidence, not population representativeness or inferential uncertainty
wall_time_amendment_assessment: SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS: four old right-censored conditions completed under no wall-time research cap, supporting policy censoring rather than an algorithmic feasibility boundary; this does not establish n>=5 feasibility
